answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade at the wharf of the agent marketplace. The stake is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits, while honest agents get theirs back at dawn of each settlement cycle. A zephyr of cheap identities cannot pass, because the cost scales linearly with each Sybil and deposits stay locked long enough that a flash flood of new accounts cannot earn before the fraud check clears.
